name: Corporate Prayer
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of corporate prayer as a unified, solemn gathering of God's people, often accompanied by fasting and humility, as seen when Israel assembled in Nehemiah 9:1 and in the calls for solemn assemblies in Joel 1:14 and 2:15. The house of God is described as a house of prayer for all people (Isaiah 56:7), highlighting communal worship and intercession. Jesus teaches against praying for show (Matthew 6:5) and affirms the power of united prayer when two or more agree in asking (Matthew 18:19), underscoring the spiritual authority and blessing inherent in corporate petition.
